resources.string: Titan Gamepad turns the Titan 2 Elite physical keyboard into a virtual gamepad or a virtual mouse while it is toggled on. No keys are blocked: mapped keys send their gamepad or mouse input and also pass through, unmapped keys send blank input and pass through. Controller mode: WASD D-pad, KLJI face, Q/E shoulders, C/N L2/R2, T/Y L3/R3, Enter Select, Space Start, M Menu. Mouse mode: WASD move, O left click, P right click, no scroll keys. Mouse mode pauses automatically while an editable text field has focus, so keys type normally, and resumes when focus leaves the field. Launch the Titan Gamepad icon to cycle Off, Controller, Mouse, Off.
